schema.description: Inferred (all-source, Alex 2026-11-24) from WIKIPEDIA-VIDEO-GAME-DEVELOPMENT, Wikipedia revision 1386781062 (wikitext sha256 f2c11900c465ac9ac3b5d91b706f3b7a23789f000ade7bae1181dabc96892a0c): section Milestones, the common milestones for a two-year development cycle, in order. First playable: the game version containing representative gameplay and assets. Alpha: the stage when key gameplay functionality is implemented, and assets are partially finished. Code freeze: the stage when new code is no longer added to the game and only bugs are being corrected. Beta: a feature and asset complete version of the game, when only bugs are being fixed. Code release: the stage when many bugs are fixed and game is ready to be shipped or submitted for console manufacturer review. Gold master: the final game's build that is used as a master for the production of the game.
schema.title: Game development milestone
